arxiv-2012-09656.title: Large Deviations in Continuous Time Random Walks
arxiv-2012-09656.creator: Adrian Pacheco-Pozo, Igor M. Sokolov
arxiv-2012-09656.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Adrian Pacheco-Pozo, Igor M. Sokolov. We discuss large deviation properties of continuous-time random walks (CTRW) and present a general expression for the large deviation rate in CTRW in terms of the corresponding rates for the distributions of steps’ lengths and waiting times. In the case of Gaussian distribution of steps’ lengths the general expression reduces to a sequence of two Legendre transformations applied to the cumulant generating function of waiting times.

arxiv-2112-07480.title: Weak-strong uniqueness and energy-variational solutions for a class of viscoelastoplastic fluid models
arxiv-2112-07480.creator: Thomas Eiter, Katharina Hopf, Robert Lasarzik
arxiv-2112-07480.description: Abstract We study a model for a fluid showing viscoelastic and viscoplastic behavior, which describes the flow in terms of the fluid velocity and an internal stress. This stress tensor is transported via the Zaremba–Jaumann rate, and it is subject to two dissipation processes: one induced by a nonsmooth convex potential and one by stress diffusion.

arxiv-2204-11636.title: Non-Commutative Stochastic Processes and Bi-Free Probability Thanks: This research was completed with the support of NSERC (Canada) grant RGPIN-2017-05711.
arxiv-2204-11636.creator: Paul Skoufranis
arxiv-2204-11636.description: Abstract . In this paper, a connection between bi-free probability and the theory of non-commutative stochastic processes is examined. Specifically it is demonstrated that the transition operators for non-commutative stochastic processes can be modelled using technology from bi-free probability. Several important examples are recovered with this approach and new formula are obtained for processes with free increments.

arxiv-2204-12905.title: Temperature induced giant shift of phonon energy in epitaxial boron nitride layers
arxiv-2204-12905.creator: Jakub Iwański, Piotr Tatarczak, Mateusz Tokarczyk, Grzegorz Kowalski, Aleksandra K. Dąbrowska, Johannes Binder, Roman Stępniewski, Andrzej Wysmołek
arxiv-2204-12905.description: Abstract The recent progress in the growth of large-area boron nitride epilayers opens up new possibilities for future applications. However, it remains largely unclear how weakly attached two-dimensional BN layers interact with their substrate and how their properties are influenced by defects.

arxiv-2303-15757.title: Multiphoton processes and higher resonances in the quantum regime of the free-electron laser
arxiv-2303-15757.creator: Peter Kling, Enno Giese
arxiv-2303-15757.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Peter Kling, Enno Giese. Despite exhibiting novel radiation features, the operation of the proposed quantum free-electron laser would have the drawback that the number of emitted photons is limited by one per electron, significantly reducing the output power of such a device. We show that relying on different resonances of the initial momentum of the electrons increases the number of emitted photons, but also increases the required length of the undulator impeding an experimetal realization.

arxiv-2304-01001.title: Observation of spin-wave moiré edge and cavity modes in twisted magnetic lattices
arxiv-2304-01001.creator: Hanchen Wang, Marco Madami, Jilei Chen, Hao Jia, Yu Zhang, Rundong Yuan, Yizhan Wang, Wenqing He, Lutong Sheng, Yuelin Zhang, Jinlong Wang, Song Liu, Ka Shen, Guoqiang Yu, Xiufeng Han, Dapeng Yu, Jean-Philippe Ansermet, Gianluca Gubbiotti, Haiming Yu
arxiv-2304-01001.description: Abstract We report the experimental observation of the spin-wave moiré edge and cavity modes using Brillouin light scattering spectro-microscopy in a nanostructured magnetic moiré lattice consisting of two twisted triangle antidot lattices based on an yttrium iron garnet thin film. Spin-wave moiré edge modes are detected at an optimal twist angle and with a selective excitation frequency.

arxiv-2304-09175.title: Memento : Facilitating Effortless, Efficient, and Reliable ML Experiments
arxiv-2304-09175.creator: Zac Pullar-Strecker, Xinglong Chang, Liam Brydon, Ioannis Ziogas, Katharina Dost, Jörg Wicker (✉)
arxiv-2304-09175.description: Abstract Running complex sets of machine learning experiments is challenging and time-consuming due to the lack of a unified framework. This leaves researchers forced to spend time implementing necessary features such as parallelization, caching, and checkpointing themselves instead of focussing on their project.

arxiv-2310-06511.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation for Transfer Learning
arxiv-2310-06511.creator: Dong Bok Lee, Seanie Lee, Joonho Ko, Kenji Kawaguchi, Juho Lee, Sung Ju Hwang
arxiv-2310-06511.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dong Bok Lee, Seanie Lee, Joonho Ko, Kenji Kawaguchi, Juho Lee, Sung Ju Hwang. Dataset distillation aims to optimize a small set so that a model trained on the set achieves performance similar to that of a model trained on the full dataset. While many supervised methods have achieved remarkable success in distilling a large dataset into a small set of representative samples, however, they are not designed to produce a distilled dataset that can be effectively used to facilitate self-supervised pre-training.

arxiv-2402-02351.title: Effective model and electron correlations in trilayer nickelate superconductor La 4 Ni 3 O 10
arxiv-2402-02351.creator: Peng-Fei Tian, Hao-Tian Ma, Xing Ming, Xiao-Jun Zheng, Huan Li
arxiv-2402-02351.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Peng-Fei Tian, Hao-Tian Ma, Xing Ming, Xiao-Jun Zheng, Huan Li. Recently, signatures of superconductivity with critical temperature from 20 to 30 K have been reported in pressured trilayer nickelate La 4 Ni 3 O 10 through a pressure-induced structure transition. Here we explore the evolution of electronic structures and electronic correlations in different phases of La 4 Ni 3 O 10 under corresponding pressure regions, by using density functional theory (DFT) combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT).

arxiv-2410-06196.title: A Chandra Study of the NGC 7618/UGC 12491 Major Group Merger at Apogee: Multiple Cold Fronts, Boxy Wings, Filaments and Arc-Shaped Slingshot Tails
arxiv-2410-06196.creator: M. E. Machacek, C. Jones, R. P. Kraft, W. R. Forman, E. Roediger, A. Sheardown, J. Wan
arxiv-2410-06196.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by M. E. Machacek, C. Jones, R. P. Kraft, W. R. Forman, E. Roediger, A. Sheardown, J. Wan. Analyses of major group mergers are key to understanding the evolution of large-scale structure in the Universe and the microphysical properties of the hot gas in these systems.

arxiv-2503-12538.title: EmoBipedNav: Emotion-aware Social Navigation for Bipedal Robots with Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2503-12538.creator: Wei Zhu, Abirath Raju, Abdulaziz Shamsah, Anqi Wu, Seth Hutchinson, Ye Zhao
arxiv-2503-12538.description: Abstract This study presents an emotion-aware navigation framework – EmoBipedNav – using deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for bipedal robots walking in socially interactive environments. The inherent complex dynamics of bipedal robots challenge their safe maneuvering capabilities in dynamic environments. Furthermore, the intricacies of social interactions and cues such as emotions significantly compound the challenges of bipedal robot navigation.

arxiv-2504-21045.title: Leveraging LLM to Strengthen ML-Based Cross-Site Scripting Detection DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: ACM Workshop on Wireless Security and Machine Learning; June 30– July 03, 2025; Arlington, VA ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Security and privacy Web application security
arxiv-2504-21045.creator: Dennis Miczek, Divyesh Gabbireddy, Suman Saha
arxiv-2504-21045.description: Abstract . According to the Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP), Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) is a critical security vulnerability. Despite decades of research, XSS remains among the top 10 security vulnerabilities. Researchers have proposed various techniques to protect systems from XSS attacks, with machine learning (ML) being one of the most widely used methods.

arxiv-2505-00463.creator: Shun Maeta
arxiv-2505-00463.description: Abstract . In this paper, we classify complete, nontrivial shrinking and steady quasi-Yamabe gradient solitons whose scalar curvature is bounded below by the soliton constant. We also classify complete, nontrivial expanding and steady quasi-Yamabe gradient solitons whose scalar curvature is bounded above by the soliton constant. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C21, 53C25, 53C20 1.

arxiv-2506-09953.title: Outside Knowledge Conversational Video (OKCV) Dataset - Dialoguing over Videos
arxiv-2506-09953.creator: Benjamin Reichman, Constantin Patsch, Jack Truxal, Atishay Jain, Larry Heck
arxiv-2506-09953.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Benjamin Reichman, Constantin Patsch, Jack Truxal, Atishay Jain, Larry Heck. In outside knowledge visual question answering (OK-VQA), the model must identify relevant visual information within an image and incorporate external knowledge to accurately respond to a question. Extending this task to a visually grounded dialogue setting based on videos, a conversational model must both recognize pertinent visual details over time and answer questions where the required information is not necessarily present in the visual information.

arxiv-2509-00140.title: LLM-based Triplet Extraction for Automated Ontology Generation in Software Engineering Standards DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Information syst
arxiv-2509-00140.creator: Songhui Yue
arxiv-2509-00140.description: Abstract . Ontologies have supported knowledge representation and white-box reasoning for decades; thus, the automated ontology generation (AOG) plays a crucial role in scaling their use. Software engineering standards (SES) consist of long, unstructured text (with high noise) and paragraphs with domain-specific terms. In this setting, relation triple extraction (RTE), together with term extraction, constitutes the first stage toward AOG.

arxiv-2510-20193.title: Multimedia-Aware Question Answering: A Review of Retrieval and Cross-Modal Reasoning Architectures Conference: Proceedings of the 2nd ACM Workshop in AI-powered Question & Answering Systems; October 27–28, 2025; Dublin, Ireland Proceedings of the 2nd ACM Workshop in AI-powered Question & Answering S
arxiv-2510-20193.creator: Rahul Raja, Arpita Vats
arxiv-2510-20193.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rahul Raja, Arpita Vats. Question Answering (Q&A) systems have traditionally relied on structured text data, but the rapid growth of multimedia content—images, audio, video, and structured metadata has introduced new challenges and opportunities for retrieval-augmented QA. In this survey, we review recent advancements in Q&A systems that integrate multimedia retrieval pipelines, focusing on architectures that align vision, language, and audio modalities with user queries.

arxiv-2601-16045.title: AgriPINN: A Process-Informed Neural Network for Interpretable and Scalable Crop Biomass Prediction Under Water Stress Thanks: Citation : Authors. Title. Pages…. DOI:000000/11111.
arxiv-2601-16045.creator: Yue Shi, Liangxiu Han*, Xin Zhang, Tam Sobeih, Amit Kumar Srivastava, Krishnagopal Halder, Frank Ewert, Thomas Gaiser, Nguyen Huu Thuy, Dominik Behrend
arxiv-2601-16045.description: Abstract Accurate prediction of crop above-ground biomass (AGB) under water stress is critical for monitoring crop productivity, guiding irrigation, and supporting climate-resilient agriculture. Data-driven models scale well but often lack interpretability and degrade under distribution shift, whereas process-based crop models (e.g. DSSAT, APSIM, LINTUL5) require extensive calibration and are difficult to deploy over large spatial domains.

Tantalum (Ta) was chosen as a specific exemplar for programmatic purposes. It was hoped that a deeper understandi

pmc-10577457.title: The Effect of Curcumin on the Gut-Brain Axis: Therapeutic Implications
pmc-10577457.creator: Ayesheh Enayati, Aida Soghi, Alexandra E Butler, Manfredi Rizzo, Amirhossein Sahebkar
pmc-10577457.description: The gut-brain axis describes the bidirectional communication between the gut, the enteric nervous system, and the central nervous system. The gut-brain axis has attracted increasing attention owing to its regulatory effect on dysbiosis and a wide range of related diseases.

pmc-10622836.title: Crystal structure of histone deacetylase 6 complexed with (R)-lipoic acid, an essential cofactor in central carbon metabolism
pmc-10622836.creator: Paris R Watson, Juana Goulart Stollmaier, David W Christianson
pmc-10622836.description: The enzyme cofactor (R)-lipoic acid plays a critical role in central carbon metabolism due to its catalytic function in the generation of acetyl-CoA, which links glycolysis with the tricarboxylic acid cycle. This cofactor is also essential for the generation of succinyl CoA within the tricarboxylic acid cycle.

pmc-10638440.title: Structural basis of bile salt extrusion and small-molecule inhibition in human BSEP
pmc-10638440.creator: Hongtao Liu, Rossitza N. Irobalieva, Julia Kowal, Dongchun Ni, Kamil Nosol, Rose Bang-Sørensen, Loïck Lancien, Henning Stahlberg, Bruno Stieger, Kaspar P. Locher
pmc-10638440.description: BSEP (ABCB11) is an ATP-binding cassette transporter that is expressed in hepatocytes and extrudes bile salts into the canaliculi of the liver. BSEP dysfunction, caused by mutations or induced by drugs, is frequently associated with severe cholestatic liver disease. We report the cryo-EM structure of glibenclamide-bound human BSEP in nanodiscs, revealing the basis of small-molecule inhibition.

pmc-10654147.title: Increased serum 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D levels in gynecologic cancer patients with Post-Acute-Covid-Sequela (PASC)/Long COVID
pmc-10654147.creator: Stefania Bellone, Eric E Siegel, Alessandro D Santin
pmc-10654147.description: Highlights•Growing evidence suggests that Vitamin D3, an essential nutrient, may have a protective role in COVID-19-related health outcomes.•Up to 60% of cancer patients diagnosed with COVID-19 may develop Post-Acute-Sequelae of Covid-(PASC)/Long Covid (LC).•Plasma levels of the active form (1,25OH) but not the storage form (25 OH) of vitamin D3 is significantly elevated in PASC/LC cancer patients.

pmc-11443005.title: Comparative analyses of plastomes in Allaeanthus and Malaisia: structure, evolution, and phylogeny
pmc-11443005.creator: Li-Na Zhou, Lang-Xing Yuan, Pan Li, Bo-Liang Wei, Jin-Rui Lei, Zong-Zhu Chen, Zhi-Hua Zhang, Xin-Jie Jin, Yi-Qing Chen, Yong-Hua Zhang
pmc-11443005.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The small genera Allaeanthus and Malaisia within the Moraceae have important edible, medicinal, and economic value. However, complete plastome blueprints and a well-resolved evolutionary history of these two genera are still lack, thereby limiting their conservation and application. The recent discovery of a new distribution of Allaeanthus kurzii in Hainan, China, marked by the collection of two unique samples, alongside three samples of Malaisia scandens, has opened new avenues for research.

pmc-11511092.title: Spectrum and Incidence of Adverse Reactions Post Immunization in the Taiwanese Population (2014–2019): An Analysis Using the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program
pmc-11511092.creator: Wan-Chun Lai, Chin-Hui Yang, Yhu-Chering Huang, Nan-Cheng Chiu, Chih-Jung Chen
pmc-11511092.description: Background: Post-marketing surveillance is crucial for gathering data on vaccine reactogenicity, enhancing public trust in immunization, and promoting vaccine uptake. This study aims to characterize adverse events following immunization (AEFIs) and estimate the incidence rates of adverse reactions (ARs) associated with vaccines included in Taiwan’s Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI).

pmc-12372186.title: Effectiveness of the sterile insect technique in controlling Aedes albopictus as part of an integrated control measure: evidence from a first small-scale field trial in Switzerland
pmc-12372186.creator: Diego Parrondo Monton, Damiana Ravasi, Valentina Campana, Francesco Pace, Arianna Puggioli, Matteo Tanadini, Eleonora Flacio
pmc-12372186.description: BackgroundThe invasive Asian tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus) poses growing health risks across Europe. In Switzerland, a preliminary field trial was conducted to assess the feasibility of integrating the sterile insect technique (SIT) into existing integrated vector management (IVM), which includes breeding site removal and application of biological larvicides.

pmc-12837962.title: Assessment of Vascular Remodeling in Coronary Artery Aneurysm and Ectasia Using Optical Coherence Tomography: A Comparative Analysis of Dilated and Non-Dilated Segments
pmc-12837962.creator: Patrycja Woźniak, Sylwia Iwańczyk, Konrad Stępień, Maciej Błaszyk, Maciej Lesiak, Weronika Jędraszak, Grzegorz Krupka, Tatiana Mularek-Kubzdela, Aleksander Araszkiewicz
pmc-12837962.description: Background: Coronary artery aneurysm and ectasia (CAAE) represent uncommon forms of coronary artery disease characterized by abnormal arterial dilatation and complex remodeling. The mechanisms underlying their development remain poorly defined. Optical coherence tomography (OCT) provides high-resolution evaluation of plaque morphology and vessel wall structure, offering insights into the pathophysiology of CAAE.

pmc-12958157.title: How Organisational and Socio-Cultural Contexts Shape Healthcare Workers’ Intrinsic, Prosocial, and Public Service Motivation in Africa: A Scoping Review
pmc-12958157.creator: Djibrine Diallo, Bruno Marchal, Zakaria Belrhiti
pmc-12958157.description: Background: In Africa, the poor quality of care is often attributed to a lack of motivated health workers (HWs). Most reforms implemented in African health systems rely on performance-based financial incentives. Evidence suggests that financial incentives may have adverse effects, such as crowding out autonomous forms of motivation, including intrinsic, prosocial, and public service motivation (PSM).

pmc-12965290.title: Direct detection of an asteroid’s heliocentric deflection: The Didymos system after DART
pmc-12965290.creator: Rahil Makadia, Steven R. Chesley, David Herald, Davide Farnocchia, Nancy L. Chabot, Shantanu P. Naidu, Andrew S. Rivkin, Alexandros Siakas, Damya Souami, Paolo Tanga, Sotirios Tsavdaridis, Kleomenis Tsiganis, Sébastien Bouquillon, Siegfried Eggl
pmc-12965290.description: In September 2022, NASA’s Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) spacecraft crashed into Dimorphos and demonstrated the kinetic impact method of protecting Earth from asteroids. A fraction of the impulse delivered to Dimorphos was also imparted onto the Didymos system’s barycenter, changing its heliocentric orbit.

Most agents are available in low and high doses, with the assumption that higher doses improve glycemic control. pmc-13429555.title: Identification and validation of a prognostic risk-scoring model in drug-resistant ALL and evaluation of immune micro-environment
pmc-13429555.creator: Yun-yao Li, Hong-xi Huang, Jian-wei Guan, Wang-jing Cai, Jian-pei Fang
pmc-13429555.description: ALL is the commonest childhood hematological malignancy; modern multi-agent chemotherapy cures about 80% of patients, yet roughly 20% experience primary or secondary chemotherapy resistance that sharply reduces long-term survival. The molecular circuits driving this resistance remain poorly defined, and validated biomarkers for early risk stratification are lacking.
